mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate relative to the prior month compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declined from the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and decreases in non-farm payroll employment signal a deteriorating labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE increased and PAYEMS decreased, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, rising housing starts signal improving consumer demand and construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months in the post-recession recovery regime with rising HOUST, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate relative to the prior month signals worsening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with rising UNRATE, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95 (relative to 2017=100) signals a deepening economic contraction, reducing corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures signal robust demand growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with simultaneous increases in HOUST and RSAFS, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-inflation regime (year-over-year CPIAUCSL growth below 2%), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and stimulating equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with CPIAUCSL yoy < 2%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
